---

```{r configuration, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
logo = normalizePath(params$logo, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
```

```{r couverture, results='asis'}
cat("\\renewcommand{\\brevetlogo}{\\includegraphics[height=9mm]{\\detokenize{", logo, "}}}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\thispagestyle{empty}\n\\begin{center}\n\\vspace*{35mm}\n")
cat("{\\LARGE\\bfseries Diplôme national du brevet\\par}\n\\vspace{5mm}\n{\\Large Épreuve de mathématiques\\par}\n\\vspace{4mm}\n{(version eduschool)\\par}\n\\vspace{8mm}\n{\\large Durée : 2h - 20 points\\par}\n")
cat("\\vspace{22mm}\n\\includegraphics[width=45mm]{\\detokenize{", logo, "}}\n", sep = "")
cat("\\end{center}\n")
```

```{r parties, results='asis'}
parties = if (params$mode == "corrige") {
  list("Corrigé : Partie 1" = params$corrige1, "Corrigé : Partie 2" = params$corrige2)
} else {
  c(list("Partie 1 : Automatismes" = params$partie1,
         "Partie 2 : Raisonnement et résolution de problèmes" = params$partie2),
    if (params$mode == "sujet_corrige") list("Corrigé : Partie 1" = params$corrige1,
                                              "Corrigé : Partie 2" = params$corrige2))
}
for (i in seq_along(parties)) {
  if (!nzchar(parties[[i]])) next
  cat("\\clearpage\n\\pagestyle{brevet}\n\\markright{", names(parties)[i], "}\n", sep = "")
  cat(knitr::knit_child(text = parties[[i]], quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```
